_note: v4.3-avail = v4.2-avail (same weights, layering and strict names) plus depth_chart: the starting QB losing his job without being hurt (src/model/v43.ts). Facts carry a role (starter, benched, competition) separate from health; each outlet's latest word since the team's previous game is one vote, a vote counts once 2 outlets cast it, the most recently corroborated vote wins, another QB being named the starter only corroborates (one outlet must say the starter himself was benched), and an official 'Available' cannot clear a benching because it only says he is healthy. Benched costs bench_points 3 (half the 6 for an injured starter: the coach chose the backup, so the drop-off is smaller than an injury forces), an undecided job half of that. The QB item is the larger of the health penalty and this; they do not stack. Every number is a prior. Motivated by week 12 Oklahoma-Texas A&M (Brady Hart over Marcel Reed, Reed 'Available' on the SEC report). Not logged as its own model: it is the injury layer of v5.3-fused. Approved by Drew 2026-11-23. Any change after v5.3 rows exist is a new model_version.
